text: Your pan just caught fire, so you grab a cup of water.
Bad idea. Water is heavier than oil, so it sinks right to the bottom.
The hot oil boils it instantly, and it blows up into steam, seventeen hundred times bigger.
The blast throws burning oil into the air, and you get a fireball.
Instead, turn off the burner and slide a lid over the pan.
No air, no fire. Leave the lid on, and don't carry the pan.
If the fire's too big, get out and call 911.
Tag someone who always leaves the stove on, and subscribe.
